messages:
Asha Mehta: Quick flag 1: we have ~240 accounts in the last 30 days with healthscore bump then immediate drop. looks like duplicate contact merges are resetting engagement metrics. opening thread to coordinate a fix.
Diego Rivera: can you share an example account id?
Asha Mehta: sample: ACC-99421. After merge, last_interaction became NULL and healthscore recalculated to 12.
Marta Novak: that smells like the merge job not carrying over recent_events array. current merge SQL does coalesce(last_interaction) but not aggregate events.
Riley Park: proposed quick patch: change merge job to union recent_events arrays and set last_interaction = greatest(a.last_interaction, b.last_interaction). Also add a safety check: if post-merge last_interaction is null, restore from backup snapshot.
Asha Mehta: can we gate healthscore recalculation until merge stability check passes? want to avoid transient dips triggering playbooks.
Diego Rivera: yes. add a post-merge hook: set temp_hold=true for 48h and suppress healthscore-driven outbound for held accounts.
CS Bot: automation note: creating ticket CSOPS-1127 to track merge fix, hold-window, and replay of affected accounts.
Marta Novak: timeline: I'll open a PR with the merge fix and backup-restore logic. Riley can add the hold flag in playbook prefilter.
Riley Park: will update playbook runner to skip accounts where temp_hold = true or merged_at within last 48h. deployment plan: staging dry-run today, prod w/sample 10% tomorrow.
Asha Mehta: thanks. please include a small reconciliation job to surface accounts whose healthscore changed >20 points in last 7 days so CS can review.
Diego Rivera: will add query and dashboard panel cs.health.merge-reconciles.
Marta Novak: PR linked: #678. tagging reviewers.
Asha Mehta: great work team. we'll monitor delta and revert if any customer complaints show up. :thumbsup:
